content: Kimani Vidal has been waived by the Los Angeles Chargers. (Source: Chargers Communications)

Fantasy Impact: The Chargers released several running backs on Tuesday, including Vidal, but kept Najee Harris (eye) on their active roster for Week 1, indicating that he may be close to a full return to action. As for Vidal, he remains unlikely to make an impact anywhere this season.
Nyheim Miller-Hines has been cut by the Los Angeles Chargers. (Source: Chargers Communications)

Fantasy Impact: To no surprise, Miller-Hines has been cut before the start of the regular season for the Chargers. He was always a long shot to make the roster, but the fact that he didn't make the team paired with Najee Harris starting on the active roster suggests that the latter may be ready to play sooner rather than later for the team.
Jalen Reagor has been released by the Los Angeles Chargers. (Source: Chargers Communications)

Fantasy Impact: The Chargers made a number of roster cuts on Tuesday, and Reagor was one of the players who didn't make the 53-man roster for the regular season. He may end up back with the team on the practice squad and remains irrelevant for fantasy purposes.
Taylor Heinicke has been released by the Los Angeles Chargers. (Source: Chargers Communications)

Fantasy Impact: The veteran quarterback did not make the active roster for the Chargers, meaning that Trey Lance will be their backup quarterback heading into the regular season. It remains to be seen whether or not the veteran will land somewhere else this year.
Kaleb McGary (knee) to miss entire season
Kaleb McGary (knee) will miss the entire season after being placed on injured reserve. (Source: Mike Garafolo on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: The Falcons placed McGary on injured reserve on Tuesday with no designation to return, meaning that he will be sidelined for the entire season as he recovers. This is a tough blow for Atlanta, as their offensive line was hoped to be one of the best in the league this year. The loss of a key starter like this may make efficiency a bit harder for Michael Penix Jr. and Bijan Robinson throughout the season.

He’s a name worth monitoring, but his fantasy relevance is likely over.

DeVonta Smith returns to practice Wednesday
DeVonta Smith was on the practice field Wednesday after tending to a nagging groin injury. (Source: Jeff McLane on X)

Fantasy Impact: DeVonta Smith, as well as fellow wide receiver A.J. Brown were participating in practice yesterday which is a great sign for his week 1 outlook. Smith is currently the 26th ranked wide receiver in Fantasy Pros Half PPR rankings and will see an ample amount of opportunities catching balls as the WR2 in Philly. Keep in mind A.J. Brown is prone to injury and if he goes down, Smith will immediately slide into the WR1 role.
Jalen Coker to start in slot for Panthers
Panthers GM Dan Morgan told reporters WR Jalen Coker will start in the slot for the team. (Source: Mike Kaye on Twitter)
Fantasy Impact: Coker was able to show flashes in limited opportunity last season. He'll take on an expanded role following the trade of Adam Thielen.
Tyreek Hill (oblique) remains on track to be healthy for Week 1
Dolphins coach Mike McDaniel said Tyreek Hill remains on track to be healthy for the start of the season. (Source: Cameron Wolfe on Twitter)

De'Von Achane (calf) remains on track to be healthy for Week 1
Dolphins coach Mike McDaniel said De'Von Achane remains on track to be healthy for the start of the season. (Source: Cameron Wolfe on Twitter)

JaMycal Hasty signs with Dolphins practice squad
The Dolphins signed RB JaMycal Hasty to their practice squad. (Source: Cameron Wolfe on Twitter)

Darnell Mooney (shoulder) returns to practice Thursday
Darnell Mooney was back at practice for the first time on Thursday since his injury. (Source: Terrin Waack on Twitter)

A.J. Brown was spotted on the practice field Wednesday which is great news for both the Eagles and fantasy managers alike. (Source: Zach Berman on X)

He was spotted in warmups before the final preseason game but ultimately, didn't play. This should inject some confidence into those who are looking at rostering the number one in Philly's receiving corps.
Russell Gage Jr. returns to 49ers 53-man roster
The San Francisco 49ers bought WR Russell Gage Jr. back to their 53-man roster. (Source: Ian Rapoport on Twitter)

The Cowboys traded OL Asim Richards to the New Orleans Saints. (Source: Adam Schefter on Twitter)

Landon Dickerson was able to practice on Wednesday. (Source: Dave Zangaro on Twitter)

The Cardinals re-signed WR Andre Baccellia to their practice squad. (Source: Adam Schefter on Twitter)

Michael Carter re-signs with Cardinals practice squad

Dontayvion Wicks (calf) back at practice Wednesday
Dontayvion Wicks (calf) is back at practice for the Packers on Wednesday. (Source: Bill Huber on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Wicks is still recovering from a calf injury but was able to take part in Green Bay's practice on Wednesday. That's a hopeful sign that he will be back for Week 1, but it's unclear if that will be the case or not at this point.
Jayden Reed (foot) participates in practice Wednesday
Jayden Reed (foot) participated in Green Bay's practice on Wednesday. (Source: Bill Huber on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: The Packers got a few key players back at practice on Wednesday, including Reed, who has been managing a foot injury for a while now. This is a step in the right direction for his recovery and he could be ready to go sooner rather than later, possibly by the time that Week 1 rolls around.
Khalil Shakir (ankle) returns to practice Wednesday
Khalil Shakir (ankle) returned to practice for the Bills on Wednesday. (Source: Katherine Fitzgerald on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: The veteran wideout was able to return to practice on Wednesday after being sidelined for a few weeks due to an ankle injury. This is a good sign for his Week 1 availability, but fantasy managers should still keep tabs on updates about his health for the foreseeable future.
Travis Hunter good to go for Week 1
Travis Hunter will be good to go for Week 1 of the NFL season. (Source: Demetrius Harvey on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: The rookie was previously managing an upper body injury, but he is now back to full health and should be good to go for Week 1, barring any unforeseen setbacks. It remains to be seen what his role will be for the Jaguars early on in the season.
Panthers LT Ikem Ekwonu is considered as “day to day.” (Source: Joe Person on Twitter)
Fantasy Impact: Ekwonu remains likely be to be available for the season opener next week.
The 49ers placed WR Jacob Cowing on injured reserve. (Source: Nick Wagoner on Twitter)
Fantasy Impact: Cowing recently re-aggravated a hamstring injury he had been dealing with earlier in training camp. He'll miss at least the first four weeks of the season.
Cole Strange signs with Browns practice squad
The Browns signed G Cole Strange to their practice squad.
Fantasy Impact: Strange quickly finds a new home after he had been released by the Patriots. He should have a long-term role in Cleveland.
The Bengals signed G Dalton Risner. (Source: Jordan Schultz on Twitter)
Fantasy Impact: Risner also visited the Seahawks, but he likely chose the Bengals because he has a better chance to immediately start. He should be an upgrade at right guard for Cincinnati.
Audric Estime signing with Eagles practice squad
Audric Estime is signing with the Eagles practice squad. (Source: Parker Gabriel on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Estime did not stay a free agent for long after being cut by the Broncos earlier in the week, as the Eagles are now signing him on as a member of their practice squad. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to have much of a role for the team early on in the season.
Greg Dulcich signs with Dolphins practice squad
Greg Dulcich is signing a deal with the Dolphins to join their practice squad. (Source: Tom Pelissero on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: The veteran tight end was surprisingly cut by the Giants earlier in the week after having an impressive showing throughout the preseason. He is now joining the Dolphins as a member of their practice squad, and he's a real candidate to make an impact at some point during the season with Darren Waller being the most notable name ahead of him on the depth chart.
Jordan Love (thumb) practicing in full Wednesday
Jordan Love (thumb) is practicing in full for the Packers on Wednesday. (Source: Matt Schneidman on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Love recently underwent a minor procedure to repair a thumb injury on his non-throwing hand. It seems that his recovery is going to plan, as he will be a full participant at practice on Wednesday and is expected to be ready to go by Week 1, which is great news for all of Green Bay's skill-position players.
Mark Andrews returns to practice Wednesday
Mark Andrews returned to practice for the Ravens on Wednesday. (Source: Jeff Zrebiec on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Andrews was sidelined from practice for a little while due to an undisclosed injury of some kind, but he was back out on the practice field for the Ravens on Wednesday. Barring any unforeseen setbacks, it looks like he should be ready for Week 1 of the season.
Darren Waller participates in team drills Wednesday
Darren Waller participated in team drills for the Dolphins on Wednesday. (Source: Marcel Louis-Jacques on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Waller has spent much of the offseason ramping up his conditioning after spending about a year in retirement. It looks like he is close to game shape, however, as he is now participating in team drills with the Dolphins at practice. He doesn't project to be a fantasy-relevant player this year but could be a contributor for the Dolphins with Jonnu Smith no longer on the team.
Robert Woods signing with Steelers practice squad
Robert Woods is signing a deal with the Steelers to join their practice squad. (Source: Teresa Varley)

Fantasy Impact: Woods will be back in Pittsburgh for the start of the regular season as a member of their practice squad after being previously cut by the team. He isn't expected to have much of a role for the foreseeable future.
Trey Sermon signs to Steelers practice squad
Trey Sermon has signed with the Steelers practice squad. (Source: Teresa Varley)

Fantasy Impact: To no surprise, Sermon will return to the Steelers as a member of their practice squad. He's a journeyed NFL veteran, so it's possible that he will see a small amount of real action this year in the event of an injury to someone ahead of him on the depth chart.
Jelani Woods heads to New York
Jelani Woods has been claimed by the New York Jets (Source: Tom Pelissero on X)
Fantasy Impact: After two seasons with the Indianapolis Colts, the tight end will be battling for the TE2 position with Jeremy Ruckert. He doesn't offer much, if any fantasy value as of now.
Malachi Corley signing with Browns' practice squad
Former New York Jets wide receiver Malachi Corley is signing with the Cleveland Browns' practice squad after being cut and clearing waivers. (Source: Jordan Schultz on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Corley struggled as a rookie in New York, totaling 42 scrimmage yards on five touches with just three catches. He also scored zero touchdowns, infamously dropping the ball at the goal line during a celebration. While the Jets expressed that he was one of their top prospects in the 2024 NFL Draft, the new management may not have had the same optimism. He gets a chance to reset in a new environment on the Browns' practice squad.
Riley Patterson signs with Dolphins' practice squad
The Dolphins have signed K Riley Patterson to their practice squad. (Source: Cameron Wolfe on Twitter )

Fantasy Impact: Patterson will be elevated from the practice squad to serve as the team's kicker until Jason Sanders returns from injured reserve. Patterson converted on 4-of-7 field goal attempts in five games last season.
DJ Uiagalelei signs with Chargers' practice squad
The Chargers have signed QB DJ Uiagalelei to their practice squad. (Source: Tom Pelissero on Twitter )
Fantasy Impact: Uiagalelei had a strong preseason, passing for 244 yards and two touchdowns. He will serve as the third quarterback behind backup Trey Lance and starter Justin Herbert.
Ainias Smith signs with Panthers' practice squad
The Panthers have signed WR Ainias Smith to their practice squad. (Source: Joe Person on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Smith was cut from the Eagles roster ahead of the 53-man deadline. He will provide depth at wide receiver after registering 41 yards and a touchdown on seven receptions in his rookie season.
Carson Steele signs with Chiefs' practice squad
The Chiefs have signed RB Carson Steele to their practice squad. (Source: Matt Derrick on Twitter )

Fantasy Impact: Steele went unclaimed on waivers but will remain in the organization. With the signing of Clyde Edwards-Helaire and Steele, the Chiefs ensure they have depth in the organization at running back.
Clyde Edwards-Helaire signs with Chiefs' practice squad
The Chiefs have signed RB Clyde Edwards-Helaire to their practice squad. (Source: Matt Derrick on Twitter )

Fantasy Impact: CEH was cut by the Saints on Tuesday and will return to the Chiefs after spending the 2024 season with the Saints. He will provide organizational depth at running back for Kansas City.
Chris Oladokun signs with Chiefs' practice squad
The Chiefs have signed QB Chris Oladokun to their practice squad. (Source: Matt Derrick on Twitter )
Fantasy Impact: Oladokun was unclaimed on the waiver wire and will head back to the Chiefs. He will provide roster depth behind Patrick Mahomes and Gardner Minshew.
The Carolina Panthers have enlisted the services of wide receiver Dalevon Campbell. He was claimed off waivers from the Los Angeles Chargers. (Source: Tom Pelissero on X)
Trey Palmer going to New Orleans

The New Orleans Saints won a waiver claim for Trey Palmer and will effectively end his time with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. He accumulated 51 receptions for 557 yards and four touchdowns during his time in the Sunshine State. (Source: Tom Pelissero on X)
Kimani Vidal returning to Chargers on practice squad
The Los Angeles Chargers are re-signing running back Kimani Vidal on their practice squad after he was waived ahead of the roster cutdown deadline. (Source: Matt Zenitz on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Vidal was a rookie in 2024 and did not emerge as the sleeper option he was billed to be. He did find some success with over 200 scrimmage yards and one touchdown, but he played 26% of the offensive snaps over 10 games while being a non-factor on special teams. He was inactive for games last season and will be on the practice squad in 2025 with a deeper rotation in LA.
Brett Rypien signing with Bengals practice squad
Brett Rypien is signing a deal with the Bengals to join their practice squad. (Source: Ben Baby on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Rypien spent much of the offseason with the Vikings, but he wasn't able to earn a roster spot and has ultimately been cut. He now joins the Bengals and will serve as their QB3 from the practice squad.
The Patriots are planning on releasing WR Javon Baker. (Source: Mike Reiss on Twitter )

Fantasy Impact: Baker was likely the last receiver on the depth chart based on his performance last season and seeing most of his time with the backups during the preseason. He could return on the practice squad should he clear waivers.
Frank Gore Jr. signing with Bills practice squad
Frank Gore Jr. is signing with the Bills to join their practice squad. (Source: Tom Pelissero on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: The Bills are bringing back Gore onto their practice squad after releasing him recently. Buffalo has solid depth in their backfield right now, so the path isn't clear for him to earn a spot on the active roster.
DeeJay Dallas signing with Panthers' practice squad
The Carolina Panthers are signing running back DeeJay Dallas to their practice squad after he was released by the Arizona Cardinals. (Source: Mike Kaye on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Dallas became the first player to return a kickoff for a touchdown under the new rule set and has provided value as a returner and running back for Arizona and Seattle. The Panthers already have Chuba Hubbard, Rico Dowdle, and Trevor Etienne, so Dallas may not be able to crack the rotation, but he could fit in if they face injuries.
Xazavian Valladay returning to Vikings on practice squad
Xazavian Valladay will be returning to the Vikings as a member of their practice squad. (Source: Mike Garafolo on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: The Vikings recently cut Valladay as part of their roster cutdown ahead of Week 1, but he went unclaimed on waivers and will be rejoining the team on the practice squad. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to have much of an impact this season.
Damien Martinez signs with Seahawks' practice squad
The Seahawks have signed RB Damien Martinez to their practice squad. (Source: Brady Henderson on Twitter)
Fantasy Impact: The Seahawks currently have a crowded backfield, but will return to the practice squad to provide the team with depth. He finished the preseason with 84 rushing yards on 24 carries.
Jeff Wilson Jr. signing with Dolphins practice squad
Jeff Wilson Jr. is signing a deal to join the Dolphins practice squad. (Source: Adam Schefter on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: The veteran running back has found a home for the start of the regular season, joining Miami over a week before the 2025 NFL season kicks off. Miami's running back room is currently thin and injury riddled, so the veteran could find himself on the active roster at several points throughout the season.
Tommy Devito acquired by New England
Tommy "Cutlets" Devito has been claimed by the New England Patriots after being let go by the New York Giants. (Source: Tom Pelissero on X)

Fantasy Impact: With Drake Maye starting and Joshua Dobbs backing him up, Devito will be third in line to take snaps under center for the Patriots in the 2025/26 NFL season. He has compiled 1358 passing yards, eight touchdowns and three interceptions over his career to date.
Xavier Restrepo rejoining Tennessee on practice squad
Xavier Restrepo will be returning to the Titans as a member of their practice squad. (Source: Adam Schefter on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: The Titans did not give Restrepo a spot on their active roster, but they like him and will be bringing him back to the team as a member of their practice squad. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant at all in 2025.
Erik Ezukanma signing with Jaguars practice squad
Erik Ezukanma is signing a deal with the Jaguars to join their practice squad. (Source: Tom Pelissero on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Ezukanma will be on Jacksonville's practice squad to start the season. It's unlikely that he will make a notable impact at any point, barring injuries to several of the Jaguars' key pass catchers.
Hendon Hooker signs with Panthers' practice squad
The Carolina Panthers are bringing in quarterback Hendon Hooker on their practice squad. (Source: Mike Kaye on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Hooker is entering his third season in the NFL after being a Round 3 pick following a standout senior season at Tennessee. Unfortunately, an injury kept him out during his rookie year, and he struggled in the preseason. The Volunteers' offense is not necessarily a pro-style offense and Hooker may need to continue to develop to be a backup QB, but he is also 27 years old. He can learn and develop behind veteran Andy Dalton while backing up Bryce Young.
Jake Haener re-signing with Saints' practice squad
The New Orleans Saints are bringing back quarterback Jake Haener on their practice squad, who they drafted in the fourth round of the 2023 NFL Draft. (Source: Nick Underhill on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Haener has started one game for the Saints in two seasons, playing behind QB Spencer Rattler following Derek Carr's injury in 2024. Haener was waived after losing the QB battle this season to Rattler and rookie Tyler Shough, but he is returning as their QB3 on the practice squad.
Raheim Sanders has been claimed off waivers by the Cleveland Browns (Source: Tom Pelissero on X)

Fantasy Impact: Just a day after he was released by the Los Angeles Chargers, the Cleveland Browns have picked up the running back. The RB situation in Cleveland is fluid due to rookie Quinshon Judkins off-field issues. Dylan Sampson's name has been coming up as decent second option behind Jerome Ford so Sanders will be the perceived third fiddle for now.
Easton Stick returning to Falcons on practice squad
The Atlanta Falcons are re-signing quarterback Easton Stick to their practice squad after waiving him ahead of the roster cutdown deadline. (Source: Mike Garafolo on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Stick had some solid preseason performances, receiving most of the team's reps with QB Michael Penix Jr. and Kirk Cousins sidelined. The former North Dakota State product was rumored to land in New Orleans, but he returns with Jake Haener re-signing with the Saints. He could be the team's QB3.
Tyler Huntley reuniting with Ravens on practice squad
The Baltimore Ravens are bringing back quarterback Tyler Huntley on their practice squad, who had previously made a Pro Bowl with the team. (Source: Adam Schefter on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Huntle spent some time with other organizations, like Cleveland and Miami, but found his way back to Baltimore, where he started his career as an undrafted free agent. Huntley started nine games for the Ravens over four seasons.
Kyle McCord re-signing to Eagles' practice squad
The Philadelphia Eagles are bringing back rookie quarterback Kyle McCord to their practice squad after he was waived ahead of the roster cutdown deadline. (Source: Tom Pelissero on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: McCord had a successful final season at Syracuse after transferring from Ohio State, leading the nation in several passing statistics. He did struggle during the preseason, which put him behind Tanner McKee and recent trade acquisition Sam Howell in the pecking order, but he could develop into a long-term backup.

The Washington Commanders and Sam Hartman are reuniting after the former Notre Dame quarterback was waived ahead of roster cutdown day, joining the team's practice squad. (Source: Tom Pelissero on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Hartman's release was procedural, as he had already been cut and re-signed by Washington in the past. He is behind veterans Marcus Mariota and Josh Johnson, who both made the initial 53-man roster.
Mecole Hardman Jr. added to practice squad
Mecole Hardman Jr. added to practice squad by the Green Bay Packers (Source: Jordan Schultz on X)

Fantasy Impact: Hardman didn't make the starting roster for Green Bay as he was cut yesterday but they seem to think he's worthy of sticking around with the organization. Considering how oft-injured the Packers receivers are, it may be a prudent move to have a wide receiver with 178 receptions and just over 2300 career yards waiting behind glass in case of emergency.
Lil'Jordan Humphrey added to practice squad
As per Adam Schefter, Lil'Jordan Humphrey has been signed to the New York Giants practice squad. (Source: Adam Schefter on X)

Veteran wide receiver Marquez Valdes-Scantling is signing with the San Francisco 49ers. (Source: Tom Pelissero on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Valdes-Scantling was released by the Seattle Seahawks, setting him up to find a new home. As a veteran, he was not subject to the league's waiver system and reportedly chose the Niners over the Pittsburgh Steelers, who have his old quarterback, Aaron Rodgers. SF needs healthy wide receiver help, and Valdes-Scantling brings a field-stretching element to any offense.
The New England Patriots are releasing Kendrick Bourne, who had been a subject of trade rumors and dealt with injuries over the offseason. (Source: Tom Pelissero on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Bourne missed time during training camp with a foot injury but has been a productive receiver in the NFL. He had 800 yards in 2021 and has 400+ yards in five of his eight seasons. Minnesota reportedly had tried to trade for Bourne before acquiring Adam Thielen, but the San Francisco 49ers could emerge as a landing spot, according to NFL Network's Mike Garafolo.
Kyle Hamilton lands four-year contract extension
The Baltimore Ravens and safety Kyle Hamilton have reportedly come to terms on a four-year contract extension worth $100.4 million. (Source: Jordan Schultz on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Hamilton, arguably the best safety in the league, has been a crucial part of Baltimore's defense. He has shown versatility with seven sacks, five picks, 18 tackles for loss, and four forced fumbles, proving that he can impact every facet of the game. He has an expert consensus ranking as the DB2 in IDP leagues, according to FantasyPros' data.
Rashee Rice will serve six-game suspension
Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice is accepting a six-game suspension that will take effect in Week 1. (Source: Tom Pelissero on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Rice will be eligible to return to the field after Week 7, after facing a suspension for his 2024 multi-car accident in Dallas. The arbitration for this suspension had dragged on for a while, but there is finally a definitive timeline. While this makes Rice a tricky pick in fantasy, WR Xavier Worthy and TE Travis Kelce could see extended usage in his absence to start the season, with the ability to occupy similar parts of the field. Rookie Jalen Royals could be involved as well.

A.J. Brown told reporters he will be good to go in Thursday's season opener against the Cowboys. (Source: Jeff McLane on Twitter)

Tanner McKee is still not practicing with the Eagles. (Source: Zach Berman on Twitter)

Jalen Coker (quad) placed on IR, out 4-6 games

The Patriots released veteran safety Jabrill Peppers. (Source: Adam Schefter on Twitter)
Fantasy Impact: It is a bit of a shocking move. Peppers still has $4.32 million guaranteed remaining on his contract for this season. He should draw plenty of interest in free agency.
Trevor Penning (foot) could be ready for Week 1
Saints OL Trevor Penning could be ready for the start of the season. (Source: Around the NFL on Twitter)
Fantasy Impact: Penning is reportedly out of his walking boot. He'll have another week to get fully healthy.
Harrison Smith (personal) to be evaluated weekly
Harrison Smith will be evaluated weekly with a personal health matter. (Source: Ben Goessling on Twitter)
Fantasy Impact: Smith has been out since August 11. He remains on the active roster.
Tyler Guyton (knee) practices in full Tuesday
Tyler Guyton (knee) practiced in full for the Cowboys on Tuesday. (Source: Tommy Yarrish on Twitter)

It looks like he is trending towards playing on Thursday night in the NFL's season opener, but we won't know his official status until later in the week. His presence would be good news for Dak Prescott and the Cowboys' offense as a whole in a tough matchup against Philadelphia's defense.
Trevon Diggs (knee) logs full practice Tuesday
Trevon Diggs (knee) logged a full practice session again on Tuesday. (Source: Tommy Yarrish on Twitter)

Russell Gage Jr. released by 49ers with intent to re-sign

If he lands back in San Francisco, the team is planning to elevate him to the active roster for Sunday's season opener against the Seahawks, which will help to shore up the depth in their receiving core.
Jake Haener signing with Saints practice squad
Jake Haener is signing a deal with the Saints to join their practice squad. (Source: New Orleans Saints)

Fantasy Impact: Haener lost the quarterback competition this offseason, but the team still likes what he brings to the table and will re-sign him as a member of their practice squad. He isn't expected to see any action for the Saints anytime soon, barring injuries to the guys ahead of him on the depth chart.
Tommy Mellott joining Saints practice squad
Tommy Mellott is signing a deal with the Saints to join their practice squad. (Source: New Orleans Saints)

Fantasy Impact: The rookie will land with the Saints as a member of their practice squad after being cut by the Raiders earlier in the offseason. He isn't expected to have a notable role to play for the team this season.
Eli Ricks expected to sign with Eagles' practice squad
Eli Ricks is expected to sign a deal with Philadelphia to join their practice squad. (Source: Mike Zenitz on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Philadelphia will be re-signing Ricks to their practice squad after recently making the decision to release him. He has been an active contributor for them over the past couple of seasons, so he is a real candidate to be elevated and see in-game action on a week-to-week basis.
Tre' Harris off injury report Tuesday
Tre' Harris is off of the injury report and was a full participant at practice on Tuesday. (Source: Los Angeles Chargers on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Harris was dealing with an undisclosed injury earlier in the offseason, but it's no longer an issue for him and he should be good to go for Friday night's game. Fantasy managers should pay attention to what the rookie's workload looks like in his NFL debut against a tough Kansas City defense.
Elijah Molden (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Tuesday. (Source: Los Angeles Chargers on Twitter)

Boston Scott works out for Indianapolis Colts
Veteran running back Boston Scott worked out for the Indianapolis Colts ahead of Week 1 of the 2025-26 NFL season. (Source: Mike Garafolo on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Scott had worked out previously for the Baltimore Ravens in mid-August, but nothing came of the meeting. The former Philadelphia Eagles running back most recently spent time with the Pittsburgh Steelers on their practice squad in 2024, and he was with the Los Angeles Rams in training camp before that. He has not played in an NFL game since the 2023 season, but he can be a veteran option for a team that needs depth.
Deuce Vaughn works out for Broncos Tuesday
The Denver Broncos worked out running back Deuce Vaughn on Tuesday, Sept. 2, ahead of their Week 1 matchup with the Tennessee Titans. (Source: Jordan Schultz on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Vaughn is entering his third season in the NFL after being drafted in the sixth round in 2023. He has not been particularly productive, averaging 2.8 yards per carry over his career, but he has versatility as a pass-catcher. Sean Payton has worked with smaller running backs in the past, but Vaughn is likely no more than a practice squad addition.
Najee Harris (eye) logs full practice on Tuesday
Los Angeles Chargers running back Najee Harris (eye) logged a full participation in practice on Tuesday, Sept. 2, ahead of LA's Friday night season opener. (Source: Los Angeles Chargers on Twitter)

He will be competing with rookie RB Omarion Hampton for snaps, and it is still uncertain whether he will be active in Week 1; however, the team has expressed optimism about his status in recent weeks. He has rushed for 1,000+ yards in every season of his career, providing stability that made him an early addition in free agency.
Jacory Croskey-Merritt listed as Commanders' RB4

He could certainly have a bigger role than RB4, but as a seventh-round rookie, his listing could be more about him earning the role. He is also dealing with an injury that kept him out of the preseason closer, but he is an intriguing option in Washington's offense and a massive climber in fantasy circles.
Chris Rodriguez Jr. listed RB3 on Week 1 depth chart
The Washington Commanders have listed running back Chris Rodriguez Jr. as the team's No. 3 running back on their Week 1 depth chart. (Source: Nicki Jhabvala on Twitter)

Jeremy McNichols listed as Commanders' RB2
The Washington Commanders have listed running back Jeremy McNichols as the team's No. 2 running back on their Week 1 depth chart. (Source: Nicki Jhabvala on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: McNichols had some strong moments in 2024, his first season with the Commanders. He averaged 4.7 yards per carry and started one game, carrying the ball seven times for 42 yards. He will likely continue to rotate in throughout the season, seeing 6+ touches in six games last season.

He shone playing alongside Brian Robinson Jr. in 2024, averaging 6.5 yards per touch, his highest number since 2019. He could certainly cede work as the season goes on to the younger rotation, but even at the age of 30, he is expected to have a role in Washington's offense.
Pierre Strong Jr. waived from Browns' IR

His injury status is not currently clear, but considering he is likely being waived after reaching an injury settlement with the Browns, he is likely looking to land on a roster to start the season.

McKee should be the Eagles' QB2 when healthy, playing behind Jalen Hurts, but he could compete with Howell (who has started 18 games in his career) when he returns to practice.
Landon Dickerson (back) practices in full on Tuesday
Philadelphia Eagles guard Landon Dickerson (back) was a full participant at practice on Tuesday, Sept. 2, ahead of the NFL season opener. (Source: Philadelphia Eagles on Twitter)

Fantasy Impact: Dickerson, who is dealing with a back injury, was a non-participant in practice to open the week before bouncing back to a full-time status on Tuesday. This is a strong indication of his availability on Thursday, Sept. 4, when the Eagles will face the Dallas Cowboys. Dickerson is entering Year 5 off his third straight Pro Bowl nod.
Davis Mills signs one-year extension with Texans
The Houston Texans and quarterback Davis Mills have agreed to terms on a one-year extension worth a guaranteed $7 million. (Source: Adam Schefter on Twitter)

The former Stanford product was a third-round pick in 2021, starting 26 games over his first two seasons. Robert Woods released from Steelers' practice squad
The Pittsburgh Steelers have released veteran wide receiver Robert Woods from their practice squad. (Source: Pittsburgh Steelers on Twitter)

However, it is unclear if he will be a part of any organization by Week 1.

Jaylon Johnson dealt with groin injury during training camp

Marquise Brown (ankle/foot) 'has done everything' at practice this week
Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Marquise Brown has done "everything" in practice this week. (Source: Around the NFL on Twitter)

Graham Glasgow (leg) on track to play in Week 1

Calvin Austin III expected to be good to go for Week 1
Steelers coach Mike Tomlin said he expects WR Calvin Austin III to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Jets. (Source: Brooke Pryor on Twitter)

Free agent WR Kendrick Bourne is meeting with the Commanders on Tuesday. (Source: Around the NFL on Twitter)

Gabe Davis is signing with the Buffalo Bills. (Source: Adam Schefter on Twitter)

Christian Gonzalez (hamstring) aiming to practice this week
Christian Gonzalez (hamstring) targeting a return to practice this week. (Source: Doug Kyed on Twitter)

Stefon Diggs should be ready to play Sunday
Stefon Diggs (ACL) to play in Week 1 for Patriots. (Source: Doug Kyed on Twitter)

The veteran receiver signed with the Patriots this offseason and heads into his first campaign in New England atop head coach Mike Vrabel's depth chart. Kenneth Walker III (foot) gets in full practice Monday

Jaydon Blue (ankle) not on injury report for Thursday

DeVonta Smith (groin) without injury designation for Week 1

A.J. Brown (hamstring) off injury report for Thursday

Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him in this matchup, barring any unforeseen setbacks in his recovery.
Isaiah Likely (foot) was a non-participant in Baltimore's practice on Monday. (Source: Jamison Hensley on Twitter)

Mark Andrews is expected to get more work if the young tight end is sidelined against the Bills.
Hunter Renfrow will play in Sunday's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars. (Source: Steve Reed on Twitter)

Dee Eskridge did not take part in Monday's practice due to an undisclosed injury. (Source: Joe Schad on Twitter)

Matthew Stafford (back) expected to be good to go Sunday
Rams head coach Sean McVay said he expects Matthew Stafford to start against the Texans on Sunday. (Source: Taylor Bisciotti on Twitter)

Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said Quentin Johnston has cleared concussion protocol. (Source: Around the NFL on Twitter)

The Falcons still consider Darnell Mooney as day-to-day.

Adam Schefter reports that it is still “uncertain” if Packers EDGE Micah Parsons will play in Week 1. (Source: Adam Schefter on Twitter)

Jauan Jennings was seen at practice on Monday. (Source: Nick Wagoner on Twitter)

C.J. Gardner-Johnson (knee) expected to play in Week 1
Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said S C.J. Gardner-Johnson is expected to play in Week 1 against the Rams. (Source: Jonathan M Alexander on Twitter)

Cade Otton practiced on Monday. (Source: Rick Stroud on Twitter)

Darren Waller (return to football) on track to play Sunday
